title: Barracks construction ordered in November 1942
summary: German authorities ordered several dozen barracks to be built in the Bialystok area in November 1942; the construction department carried out the work, but its organizational identity is not explicit.
uncertaintyNote: The passage states that German power ordered construction, but does not explicitly identify the Jewish Council as a participant in this specific order.
